title: The Welcome Committee
description: Maple Court's Welcome Committee runs the friendliest bake sale in the county. It also runs license plates, a watchlist, and a man named Doug. Tonight the new neighbor calls in.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're on Snazzie FM, and tonight we're celebrating community. We've got the head of the Maple Court Welcome Committee on the line, plus a brand new resident. Patricia, welcome.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: A welcome committee. That sounds nice. That sounds normal.

lines.speaker: committee-patricia
lines.text: Thank you so much, Ronnie. And let me just say, we are a friendly street. We do a bake sale every Sunday. <p:0.3> Banana bread. Smiles. The whole thing.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Banana bread. Now that's the heart of a neighborhood, Barry.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Okay, hi, yeah, I'm the new guy. I moved into number eleven on Tuesday. <p:0.3> Can I ask why there's a folder?

lines.speaker: committee-patricia
lines.text: A welcome folder, dear. Every new resident gets one.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: It has my license plate in it. <p:0.3> It has a photo of my car. From above.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: From above?

lines.speaker: committee-patricia
lines.text: That's just Doug, with the drone. Doug does the welcome photos. <p:0.3> It's a friendly drone.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: A neighbor who takes your picture. Now that's hospitality you don't see anymore.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: It also has my mother's maiden name. <p:0.3> I never told anyone my mother's maiden name.

lines.speaker: committee-patricia
lines.text: We like to know who we're welcoming, dear. It's all in good fun.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Patricia. <p:0.3> Patricia, is the man at number eleven aware of the watchlist?

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: The WHAT?

lines.speaker: committee-patricia
lines.text: Doug, we are LIVE. <p:0.3> It's not a watchlist, dear. It's a community engagement spreadsheet.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Wait, the drone guy is named Doug AND the spreadsheet guy is named Doug?

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: There is only one Doug. <p:0.3> Doug is the committee.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: One man, doing it all. Bake sale, drone, spreadsheet. <p:0.3> That's a model citizen, Barry.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Patricia, why is there a green dot next to my name and a red dot next to the lady at number nine?

lines.speaker: committee-patricia
lines.text: Green means we like you, dear. <p:0.3> Right now. Conditionally.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Number nine put her bins out on a Wednesday. <p:0.3> Bins are Thursday. Doug remembers.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: What happens at red, Patricia? <p:0.3> Like, what does a red dot actually mean?

lines.speaker: committee-patricia
lines.text: Nothing happens, Barry. <p:0.3> We just stop saving her a slice. And then the lights go funny near her house.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: The lights go funny? <p:0.3> What does that mean, the lights go funny?!

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Doug knows where the breaker is.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: He maintains the infrastructure too. <p:0.3> This Doug is an asset to the community.

lines.speaker: committee-patricia
lines.text: He really is, Ronnie. He hasn't slept since the spring fete, bless him.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Okay, I'd like to be taken OFF the spreadsheet. <p:0.3> Effective immediately. Take me off it.

lines.speaker: committee-patricia
lines.text: Oh, dear. <p:0.3> Nobody comes off the spreadsheet. You can only change color.

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: You're going amber, number eleven. <p:0.3> I can see it from here. You're going amber.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Winston, are you AT the spreadsheet right now?

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: I am always at the spreadsheet, Barry.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: There's a drone at my window. <p:0.3> There is a drone. At my window. Right now.

lines.speaker: committee-patricia
lines.text: Smile, dear! It's for the newsletter!

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Amber!

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Red.

lines.speaker: committee-patricia
lines.text: Banana bread!

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: MY LIGHTS!

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Doug.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: His lights just went out, Ronnie. <p:0.3> The new guy's lights actually went out.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And that, folks, is what a real neighborhood feels like. <p:0.4> We'll be right back, right after Patricia saves us all a slice.

lines.speaker: committee-patricia
lines.text: ...Conditionally.
